annotations.text: Three patterns cover every shelf. The library: one ledger at every width, grouped by the collection's own shared fact, the catalog a quiet door at the tail — the table-vs-card-grid split dies. The editor: a sticky section rail beside unboxed sections — eight bordered fieldsets become hairlines you can navigate. The instrument: state said once — gear's three renderings of reservation state become the groups themselves; staffing's crew gap finally carries its act; reports keeps its shape and sheds its tiles.

Surfaces with no board of their own map to these patterns in the ADR's table: courses roster and promos take the library; team takes inset groups plus a people ledger (the page-level bulk role Save retires); the add-booking picker is a day-grouped library; the order record just goes flat. With this canvas, every surface has a named composition or a recorded deferral across items 5–10 somewhere in the stack.
